questions.explanation: Scene s2: pyramid volume is 1/3 x base area x height = 1/3 x 36 x 4 = 48 cubic centimetres.

questions.explanation: Scene s3: sphere volume is 4/3 pi r cubed = 4/3 x pi x 27 = 36 pi cubic centimetres.
questions.prompt: Find the volume of a sphere of radius 3 cm, in terms of pi.
